name: webgw-document-import-assets
description: Pinned browser-only PDF and Word import libraries

scripts.build: mkdir -p ../../js/vendor/document-import && cp node_modules/mammoth/mammoth.browser.js ../../js/vendor/document-import/mammoth.browser.js && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.mjs ../../js/vendor/document-import/pdf.mjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs ../../js/vendor/document-import/pdf.worker.mjs && cp node_modules/mammoth/LICENSE ../../js/vendor/document-import/LICENSE-mammoth.txt && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE ../../js/vendor/document-import/LICENSE-pdfjs.txt
